name: @builderforce/pipeline-route
description: The pipeline router: does this request need the FULL plan -> code -> verify pipeline, or will a QUICK single coding pass do? A logistic score over a request's lexical features (length, files named, multi-step, broad scope, question-only, action type) with the weights as data, a threshold, an `always` mode and a 'full pipeline' override; plus the pure route-report math (runs and cost per route, score histogram, misroute proxy, suggested threshold). Pure, dependency-free and I/O-free: hosts decide once per run and record the route on the usage ledger.
